title: Evolith Blueprint Schema
description: Defines a reusable project blueprint — a parametrizable template that combines a topology, SDLC phase profile, and default ruleset configuration.

rulesets.description: Ruleset $ids that apply to projects using this blueprint

parameters.description: Parametrizable variables for this blueprint (e.g. database, api-protocol)

adrs.description: ADR IDs that this blueprint mandates

topologies.description: Confirmed topology composition (mixed topologies, ADR-0104). When present it supersedes the single `topology` for design-profile derivation.

concerns.description: Multi-concern composition (ADR-0104 §3): the blueprint is the box of blocks; each concern (frontend/backend/services/mobile/data/…) composes its own blocks. `concern` is open under Convention over Configuration.

blocks.description: Blueprint-level blocks not scoped to one concern (e.g. universal blocks: adr-registry, topology-compliance-matrix, technical-maturity-evaluation).

blockList.description: Composed design-block references. Each blockKind comes from the block-type registry; new kinds are added by convention (CoC).

blockKind.description: Design-block kind from design-block-registry.json. Open under Convention over Configuration.

scope.description: core = canonical corpus; tenant = tenant private collection (ADR-0104 §11).

ref.description: Reference to the block artifact instance (Core evaluates; Tracker persists).
